evidence.notes: Search.find groups deterministic fixed local search rows by sObject type.
SearchResult exposes the local SObject row found through Test.setFixedSearchResults.
SearchResult exposes the deterministic local snippet string.
Field-specific snippets are accepted for shape and return local snippet text when present.
KnowledgeSuggestionFilter records local DTO filter inputs without calling an external suggestion service.
QuestionSuggestionFilter records local DTO filter inputs without calling an external suggestion service.
Public docs spell this parameter as KnowledegeSuggestionFilter; the local Apex surface supports the real KnowledgeSuggestionFilter/Object shape and does not add a misspelled type alias.
Search.suggest returns an empty deterministic SuggestionResults DTO.
Local suggestion DTO reports no additional external results.
Empty local suggestion result DTO returns null SObject.

source.content: @isTest private class SearchResultSuggestionDtosTest { @isTest static void resultAndSuggestionDtosUseLocalRows() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Nook Trail'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); Search.SearchResults found = Search.find('FIND {Nook} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH SNIPPET'); List<Search.SearchResult> accountResults = found.get('Account'); System.assertEquals(1, accountResults.size()); Search.SearchResult row = accountResults.get(0); Account foundAccount = (Account)row.getSObject(); System.assertEquals(account.Id, foundAccount.Id); System.assert(row.getSnippet() != null); System.assert(row.getSnippet('Name') != null); Search.KnowledgeSuggestionFilter filter = new Search.KnowledgeSuggestionFilter(); filter.addArticleType('FAQ'); filter.addDataCategory('Products', 'Trail'); filter.addTopic('Cabin'); filter.setChannel('AllChannels'); filter.setLanguage('en_US'); filter.setDataCategories(new Map<String,String>{ 'Products' => 'Trail' }); filter.setPublishStatus('Online'); filter.setValidationStatus('Validated'); Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter questionFilter = new Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter(); questionFilter.addGroupId('0F9GROUP0000001'); questionFilter.addNetworkId('0DBNETWORK00001'); questionFilter.addUserId('005USER00000001'); questionFilter.setGroupIds(new List<String>{'0F9GROUP0000002'}); questionFilter.setNetworkIds(new List<String>{'0DBNETWORK00002'}); questionFilter.setTopicId('0TOtopic0000001'); questionFilter.setUserIds(new List<String>{'005USER00000002'}); Search.SuggestionOption option = new Search.SuggestionOption(); option.setFilter(filter); option.setLimit(3); Search.SuggestionResults suggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Knowledge__kav', option); System.assertEquals(0, suggestions.getSuggestionResults().size()); System.assertEquals(false, suggestions.hasMoreResults()); Search.SuggestionResult emptySuggestion = new Search.SuggestionResult(); System.assertEquals(null, emptySuggestion.getSObject()); } }
